featured_reviews.name: Touheed Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The experience was nothing short of disturbing.
We were served Schezwan chutney with a strong, unpleasant odor.
Several cockroaches were crawling openly — even on our table.
The staff showed little concern when informed.
It left us questioning how this place is still in business.

Dining at Mehfil turned out to be one of the most unpleasant restaurant visits we’ve had.

The meal started with a serving of Schezwan chutney that had a strong, foul odor — sharp and off-putting enough to make us immediately stop eating. While we can’t say exactly how old it was, the smell alone suggested that it had definitely gone bad and should not have been served to customers under any circumstances.

Even worse, 4–5 cockroaches were visibly crawling near and on our table. (Check the attached images — they say it all.) Seeing pests in a dining space is not just unappetizing, it’s a clear sign of poor hygiene and lack of proper cleanliness protocols.

We informed the staff, but the response was indifferent and dismissive. No real apology, no action, and certainly no sense of urgency to address what we had just witnessed. It felt like this kind of complaint wasn’t new to them — which is even more worrying.

The ambiance, no matter how well intended, means nothing when you’re sitting in a pest-infested environment with questionable food quality.

⸻

Final Thoughts:

I would not recommend Mehfil to anyone until they seriously overhaul their hygiene practices and food safety standards.

Look at the photos and video, this isn’t just a bad experience, it’s a health risk.

And most shocking part was instead of accepting mistake, manager is saying we do pesticide and we have certificate. Utterly disappointed and disgusted!!!

review_photos.caption: Cockroaches and flies roaming around table

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Vikas Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a pure vegetarian, I had an extremely disappointing and disturbing experience at this restaurant. I ordered Paneer Crispy, but while eating I discovered a piece of chicken mixed in the dish. This is completely unacceptable and reflects a serious lapse in food preparation, kitchen hygiene, and quality control.

For someone who follows a strict vegetarian diet due to personal, religious, or ethical reasons, such a mistake is not minor—it is deeply offensive and distressing. The staff did not seem to understand the seriousness of the issue, which made the experience even worse.

Restaurants have a responsibility to maintain proper segregation between vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. This incident has completely broken my trust, and I would strongly advise vegetarians to be cautious before dining here.

Very disappointing experience. I expected much better standards and professionalism.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Fakht Chinese Team,

I wanted to share my positive experience with a recent order we placed that included noodles, rice, and several starters.

First off, the delivery arrived right on time. We were also very pleased with the generous portion sizes. Even the half-sized dishes were substantial enough for a full meal for one person.

Moving on to the most important part – the taste and quality – everything was absolutely scrumptious. All the dishes in your Indian Chinese section were perfectly prepared, incredibly tasty, and very satisfying.

We also appreciated the inclusion of disposable cutlery. In the past, we've had issues with other restaurants not providing these items even when requested, so it was a pleasant surprise that Fakht Chinese included them without us having to ask.

Overall, the taste and your service were outstanding. Cheers to your team, and please keep up the excellent work!

“Avoid this place like the plague.”

The food was absolutely disgusting – easily some of the worst I’ve ever had. Cold, flavorless, overcooked garbage that tasted like it was thrown together by someone who hates their job. Even basic items were ruined.
I tried calling multiple times to complain and got zero response. No one picked up, no callback, complete radio silence. That’s not just bad service – that’s disrespectful and unprofessional.

featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our weekday dinner was underwhelming. The indoor seating felt cramped, with no space to add extra chairs, so we opted for outdoor seating instead.

Unfortunately, the red lighting outside created an unpleasant ambiance, distorting the appearance of every dish—a major downside. The Chicken Strips in Peri Peri are a must try. If you like cheese, the Chicken Dilkish kebabs are worth it. While the food was decent overall, nothing stood out as exceptional or memorable.

Service was just okay, but small details like unchilled fresh lime soda without ice were disappointing.

With no standout dishes or inviting atmosphere, I don’t feel inclined to revisit this spot. Good for a casual meal, but not worth going out of your way for.

Chicken Strips in Peri Peri 5/5 (delicious)
Chicken Banjara Kebab 3/5 (basic taste)
Chicken Dilkush Kebab 4/5 (stuffed with cheese)
Chicken Alishan Kebab 3/5 (basic taste)
Fresh Lime Soda 3/5 (Not chilled)

featured_reviews.name: Adv. Varun Shenai
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place doesn't value its regular customers. They don't pay attention to the specifications of its customers. I had once ordered food without capsicum which their bill also shows. But they sent me with capsicum, which is visible in the pics.

They also have a rule. That they wud not give delivery unless ur order is atleast for Rs.500/-, which even Celebrity and Gold Coin doesn't have. For an order of Rs.300/- to deliver from Papdi to Vasai Gaon, which isn't even a couple of kilometres, they said they will charge 50/- extra. And then their delivery boy will also expect a tip. Can I not have an order of Rs.300-400? I ordered from here because it was a small order. People order from joints like these because they have a small order. If at all they have a large order, they wudve ordered from proper restaurants.

And that too when I have been a regular at this place since 2010, before even the current management took over.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Metro Chinese offers budget-friendly, basic Chinese food in Vasai's khao galli. Located opposite Dominos.  Seating is limited and it's primarily takeout.

Expect simple dishes with potential MSG overload and variable quality, like undercooked rice. No bottled water available. You can pick up from nearby stalls.

Overall this place is good for a quick, cheap meal, but don't expect fine dining. Quality can be a hit or miss.

Chicken Manchow Soup - 4/5
Singapore Chicken - 3/5
Chicken Fried Rice - 3/5
Chicken Hakka Noodles - 4/5
